title: Pressure increase factor
description: Essential: Correctly states that pressure increases by a factor of 8 when radius halves under isothermal, uniform-density conditions.

title: Small contraction time
description: Essential: Derives or states the approximate time for contraction from r0 to 0.95r0 using constant surface gravity and kinematics.

title: Free-fall collapse time
description: Essential: Applies Kepler's Third Law to a radial orbit to find the free-fall time from r0 to a much smaller radius.

title: Heat radiated isothermally
description: Important: Correctly calculates the heat radiated away during the isothermal collapse from r0 to r3 using the first law of thermodynamics.

title: Adiabatic temperature relation
description: Important: Derives the correct power-law dependence of temperature on radius for the adiabatic phase (r < r3).

title: Final radius and temperature
description: Important: Sets up and solves the energy balance (gravitational vs. thermal) to estimate the final equilibrium radius r4 and temperature T4.

title: Process identification
description: Important: Correctly identifies the collapse phases as isothermal (for r > r3) and adiabatic (for r < r3).

title: Sign error in energy
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in the work done by gravity or the first law when calculating radiated heat Q.

title: Incorrect exponent
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect exponent (e.g., from isothermal instead of adiabatic relation) for the T(r) dependence or the final equilibrium scaling.

title: Missing volume scaling
description: Pitfall: Fails to correctly relate density or volume (∝ r^3) to pressure or temperature in the scaling laws.
